label: 📋 Provenance certificate
description: Emit a signed-style certificate capturing the run's identity (run id, timestamp), the input frame's content hash, and the user-supplied source / pipeline metadata. The artifact is a JSON object suitable for archiving alongside exported data.

datasetName.label: Dataset name
datasetName.help: Human-readable name for the data being certified.

intendedUse.label: Intended use
intendedUse.help: Optional. e.g. 'Q4 board report', 'monthly compliance pack'.
